name: Ransomwhere (crowdsourced ransomware payment address dataset)
operator: Ransomwhere project (Jack Cable; dataset published on Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.6512122)
tier_rationale: Open research dataset with a named author, a citable Zenodo DOI (CC BY 4.0) and a public track record since 2021 (A8 community); used offline only (disclosure none: the export is downloaded, no value is sent).

reliability.justification: Crowdsourced, stale since 2024-10-29 and skewed to older ransomware families (P210 cond 2): a hit is a historical lead, a miss means nothing.

export.title: Ransomwhere full export https://api.ransomwhe.re/export (payment addresses, families, transactions)

terms.quote: If you use Ransomwhere in your work, please cite the following dataset: Cable, Jack. (2024). Ransomwhere: A Crowdsourced Ransomware Payment Dataset (1.1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6512122 (ransomwhe.re; Zenodo record 13999026 licence cc-by-4.0)

export.notes: Research C0494 verified_live 200 (2026-11-26): ~5.6 MB JSON, 11,186 bitcoin rows, 136 family strings, last update 2024-10-29T00:56:30Z. No ETag/Last-Modified (CloudFront); gzip works. A wrong route answers 403 {'message': 'Missing Authentication Token'} (API Gateway): the validator keeps the previous copy. Licence CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record 13999026, version 1.1.0); citation in v3lum/data/notices/ransomwhere_dataset.json. Used by ransomwhere (offline, P210).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G09-1 (P210). The export is refreshed weekly by `v3lum data update ransomwhere_export` (above 5 MB: never mid-scan) and matched offline; no address is ever sent to the provider.
